cohort: 128 pregnant women (64 in each group) at term, classified as ASA I or II, who were candidates for cesarean section with spinal anesthesia.
finding: Adding 75 mg of magnesium sulfate to hyperbaric bupivacaine during spinal anesthesia for cesarean section significantly increased the duration of postoperative analgesia and prolonged sensory and motor blockade without significant maternal or fetal side effects.
